description: This file defines a utility enumeration 'DurationFormattingSupport' that provides a static method for formatting durations from milliseconds into a concise, human-readable string representation.

classes.name: DurationFormattingSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static functions for formatting time durations.

methods.name: conciseDuration(ms:)
methods.description: Converts a duration in milliseconds to a concise string format, choosing units based on the length (ms, s, m, h, d).
